benefits: 1 GB of secure cloud storage to store, access, and legally verify authentic digital documents (Aadhaar, driving licenses, vehicle RC, marksheet, PAN) recognized under the IT Act as equivalent to physical originals.
how_to_apply: Sign up online at digilocker.gov.in or download the DigiLocker app from Play Store / App Store using Aadhaar and mobile number.
documents_required: Aadhaar number and Aadhaar-linked mobile phone (for OTP verification)
summary_en: DigiLocker is a government service for storing and sharing official documents digitally, such as certificates and ID documents. Users sign up with a mobile number and can share documents with organisations that accept them.

title: Aadhaar Act 2016
objective: Law governing the Aadhaar identity number and its use for services and benefits.
eligibility: Every resident of India who has resided in the country for 182 days or more in the preceding 12 months.
benefits: Unique 12-digit biometric and demographic digital identity card enabling targeted and transparent delivery of financial subsidies, services, and benefits directly to citizens.
how_to_apply: Book an appointment online via uidai.gov.in or walk into any Aadhaar Seva Kendra or authorized bank/post office enrollment centre for biometric and demographic capture.
documents_required: Proof of Identity (POI) and Proof of Address (POA) from UIDAI's approved list (e.g. Passport, PAN, Voter ID, Ration card)
summary_en: The Aadhaar Act is the law that governs the Aadhaar identity number. It sets rules on how Aadhaar can be used to receive services and benefits, and how personal data must be protected. Aadhaar enrolment is handled by UIDAI.

title: Right to Information Act 2005
department: Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances & Pensions
objective: Gives citizens the right to ask public authorities for information.
eligibility: Any citizen of India seeking information from any public authority or government department.
benefits: Statutory right to request information, inspect government work, documents, and records, and obtain certified samples, promoting administrative transparency and accountability within 30 days.
how_to_apply: Submit an RTI application online at rtionline.gov.in or submit a physical application with a Rs 10 fee to the Public Information Officer (PIO) of the concerned public authority.
documents_required: RTI application with specific queries; Payment receipt of Rs 10 application fee (fee waived for BPL applicants with BPL card)
summary_en: The Right to Information Act gives citizens the right to ask public authorities for information. Anyone can file an RTI application with a small fee and expect a response within a set time. It supports transparency in government.

title: Consumer Protection Act 2019
department: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food & Public Distribution
objective: Law protecting consumers from unfair trade practices and defective goods or services.
eligibility: Any individual who buys any goods or avails any service for personal use (offline or online e-commerce platforms).
benefits: Protection against unfair trade practices, misleading advertisements, and defective goods; statutory right to file consumer complaints digitally via E-Daakhil and claim compensation under product liability.
how_to_apply: File an online consumer complaint through the E-Daakhil portal (edaakhil.nic.in) or call the National Consumer Helpline at 1915.
documents_required: Purchase invoice/receipt; Warranty/guarantee card; Proof of defect/deficiency; Written grievance correspondence with seller
summary_en: The Consumer Protection Act 2019 protects consumers from unfair trade practices, defective goods and poor services. It sets up consumer commissions where people can file complaints and covers online shopping as well.

title: Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act 2016
objective: Law that protects the rights of persons with disabilities and reserves jobs and education seats.
eligibility: Persons with benchmark disabilities (at least 40% of specified disabilities across 21 recognized categories).
benefits: Statutory reservation of at least 4% in government jobs and 5% in higher educational institutions, free education for children with benchmark disabilities up to age 18, and barrier-free access.
how_to_apply: Apply for disability evaluation and issuance of Unique Disability ID (UDID) card via the swavlambancard.gov.in portal.
documents_required: Aadhaar; Passport photo; Medical hospital assessment reports / disability certificate; Proof of address
summary_en: This law protects the rights of persons with disabilities. It covers education, jobs, accessibility and protection against discrimination, and provides for reservations in government jobs and educational institutions.

title: Accessible India Campaign
objective: Makes buildings, transport and websites accessible to persons with disabilities.
eligibility: Persons with disabilities (Divyangjan), elderly persons, and citizens with reduced mobility.
benefits: Universal accessibility across the built environment (government buildings, ramps, accessible toilets, lifts), public transportation (railway stations, airports, buses), and digital ICT ecosystems.
how_to_apply: Report inaccessible public spaces or download access guides through the Sugamya Bharat app or accessibleindia.gov.in.
documents_required: None for public accessibility access
summary_en: Accessible India Campaign aims to make buildings, transport and websites easier for persons with disabilities to use. It funds changes such as ramps, accessible toilets and accessible information.

title: Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act 2005
objective: Law that gives women civil protection and relief from domestic violence.
eligibility: Any woman who is or has been in a domestic relationship and subjected to physical, sexual, verbal, emotional, or economic abuse.
benefits: Legal protection orders, residence orders (right to reside in shared household), monetary relief, temporary custody orders for children, and access to protection officers and medical shelter.
how_to_apply: File a Domestic Incident Report (DIR) before a Judicial Magistrate First Class or approach a Protection Officer, service provider, or women's helpline 181/1091.
documents_required: Written complaint detailing domestic violence incidents; Identity proof; Medical examination reports (if applicable)
summary_en: This law gives women protection and relief from domestic violence. A woman can ask a court for orders such as protection, residence and monetary relief, with the help of protection officers and support services.

title: Mission Shakti
objective: Umbrella programme for women's safety, security and empowerment.
eligibility: Women in need of care, safety, rehabilitation, protection, and socio-economic empowerment across India.
benefits: Integrated umbrella initiative with two sub-schemes: 'Sambal' for safety and security (One Stop Centres, Women Helpline 181, Beti Bachao Beti Padhao) and 'Samarthya' for women empowerment (Ujjawala, Swadhar Greh, Working Women Hostels, PM Matru Vandana).
how_to_apply: Access immediate assistance through national emergency helpline 181, local One Stop Centres (OSCs), or the WCD portal (wcd.nic.in).
documents_required: Aadhaar or identity proof (emergency rescue provided immediately without documentation)
summary_en: Mission Shakti is an umbrella programme for the safety, security and empowerment of women. It combines support services such as One Stop Centres and helplines with programmes for women's welfare and empowerment.

title: One Stop Centre Scheme
objective: Support, medical, legal and counselling services in one place for women facing violence.
eligibility: Any woman or girl affected by violence in private or public spaces, family, or workplace.
benefits: Integrated 24/7 emergency support under one roof: medical aid, police facilitation, psycho-social counseling, legal advice/court representation, and temporary shelter up to 5 days.
how_to_apply: Walk into any One Stop Centre (Sakhi Centre) located in district hospital complexes or call toll-free women helpline 181.
documents_required: None required for emergency admission, treatment, and protection
summary_en: One Stop Centres provide support under one roof to women affected by violence. They offer medical help, police and legal support, counselling and temporary shelter. A woman can reach a centre directly or through the women's helpline.

title: Mission Vatsalya
objective: Child protection and care services, including for children in need of care.
eligibility: Children in difficult circumstances, orphans, runaways, abandoned children, child victims of abuse, and children in conflict with the law.
benefits: Child protection services, family-based non-institutional care (foster care, sponsorship, adoption via CARA), institutional care in Child Care Institutions, monthly sponsorship financial aid (Rs 4,000/month), and emergency assistance via Child Helpline (1098).
how_to_apply: Call 1098 (Childline / Emergency response) or contact the District Child Protection Unit (DCPU) or Child Welfare Committee (CWC).
documents_required: Birth certificate / age proof if available; Child case history record prepared by CWC
summary_en: Mission Vatsalya is a child protection scheme. It supports children in need of care and protection through child care institutions, foster care and adoption, and community-level child protection.

title: Integrated Child Development Services
objective: Anganwadi services for nutrition, health and early learning of young children and mothers.
eligibility: Children under 6 years of age, pregnant women, and lactating mothers across rural, urban, and tribal areas.
benefits: Package of six services: supplementary nutrition, immunization, health check-up, referral services, pre-school non-formal education, and nutrition/health education delivered through Anganwadi centres.
how_to_apply: Enroll at the neighborhood Anganwadi centre in your village or urban ward.
documents_required: Aadhaar of mother and child; Mother and Child Protection (MCP) card
summary_en: The Integrated Child Development Services scheme provides services through anganwadi centres. It covers nutrition support, health check-ups and early learning for young children, and support for pregnant women and nursing mothers.

title: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act 2012
objective: Law that protects children from sexual abuse with child-friendly procedures.
eligibility: Any child below 18 years of age who has been subjected to sexual abuse, assault, harassment, or pornography.
benefits: Stringent legal protection, child-friendly reporting and court procedures, in-camera trials, mandatory interim and final financial compensation from State Legal Services Authorities, and legal counsel.
how_to_apply: Report to Special Juvenile Police Unit (SJPU), local police station, Childline (1098), or file an online complaint at the POCSO e-Box (ncpcr.gov.in).
documents_required: Statement of victim; Age proof / birth certificate / school record (mandatory for age verification)
summary_en: The POCSO Act protects children from sexual abuse and exploitation. It defines offences and sets child-friendly procedures for reporting, investigation and trial. Anyone who knows of abuse can report it to the police or Childline.

title: Post Matric Scholarship for Scheduled Castes
objective: Financial help for SC students studying after class 10.
eligibility: SC students studying at post-matriculation or post-secondary stages (Classes 11, 12, ITI, Diploma, Graduation, Post-Graduation) whose parents' annual income does not exceed Rs 2.50 lakh.
benefits: Complete reimbursement of compulsory non-refundable fees (tuition fees) and academic maintenance allowance (up to Rs 13,500/year for hostellers and Rs 7,000/year for day scholars) directly into Aadhaar-seeded bank account.
how_to_apply: Apply through the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in) or state scholarship portal with institutional verification.
documents_required: Aadhaar card; SC Caste Certificate; Family Income Certificate; Previous year academic marksheet; Fee receipt and college admission proof; Bank passbook
summary_en: This scholarship supports students from Scheduled Castes studying after class 10. It helps with costs such as fees and maintenance. Students apply through the National Scholarship Portal or their state portal.

title: PM Anusuchit Jaati Abhyuday Yojana (PM-AJAY)
objective: Combined scheme for development of Scheduled Caste communities and villages.
eligibility: Scheduled Caste individuals and SC-majority villages living below the poverty line or requiring income-generating assets.
benefits: Development of SC-dominated villages into Adarsh Grams, construction of hostels for SC students, skill development training, and capital subsidy for individual and group income-generation projects.
how_to_apply: Submit applications for livelihood and skill projects through District Social Welfare Officers or the PM-AJAY portal.
documents_required: Aadhaar; SC Caste Certificate; Income Certificate; Project proposal / bank details
summary_en: This scheme supports the development of Scheduled Caste communities. It combines three earlier schemes covering village development, project grants and hostels. It runs through state governments.

title: PM Janjatiya Adivasi Nyaya Maha Abhiyan (PM JANMAN)
objective: Housing, roads, water and services for Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Groups.
eligibility: Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Groups (PVTGs) residing in 75 notified communities across 18 states and UTs.
benefits: Saturation of 11 critical interventions including pucca housing, piped clean drinking water, electricity, road connectivity, mobile medical units, Anganwadi centres, and solar home lighting in remote tribal habitations.
how_to_apply: Implemented through multi-ministerial convergence on ground; enrollment and identity cards (Aadhaar, PM-JAY, Jan Dhan) are provided during special district saturation camps.
documents_required: Aadhaar; ST Certificate / PVTG community verification document
summary_en: PM JANMAN focuses on Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Groups. It aims to provide basic services such as housing, roads, drinking water, electricity and health and education facilities to their habitations.

title: Eklavya Model Residential Schools
objective: Quality residential schools for Scheduled Tribe students.
eligibility: Scheduled Tribe (ST) students in remote and tribal areas seeking admission to Classes 6 through 12.
benefits: 100% free quality CBSE-affiliated residential education, boarding, lodging, uniforms, books, sports facilities, and computer training for ST children.
how_to_apply: Apply and appear for the EMRS Selection Test (EMRSST) conducted annually by the National Education Society for Tribal Students (NESTS) or state tribal societies.
documents_required: ST Certificate; Birth certificate; Aadhaar; Marksheet of previous class; Passport photo
summary_en: Eklavya Model Residential Schools provide quality education to Scheduled Tribe students, in residential schools set up in tribal areas. Admission is through a selection process run by the tribal affairs authorities.

title: PM YASASVI
objective: Scholarships for OBC, EBC and DNT students.
eligibility: Students belonging to Other Backward Classes (OBC), Economically Backward Classes (EBC), and De-notified Tribes (DNT) whose annual parental income is Rs 2.5 lakh or less.
benefits: Pre-Matric scholarship (Rs 4,000/year for Classes 9 & 10) and Post-Matric scholarship (Rs 5,000 to Rs 20,000/year), as well as Top Class School/College education scholarships covering full tuition and hostel charges.
how_to_apply: Apply online on the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in) selecting the PM-YASASVI scheme under Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment.
documents_required: Aadhaar card; OBC/EBC/DNT category certificate; Annual income certificate; Previous year marksheet; Bank passbook
summary_en: PM YASASVI is a scholarship programme for OBC, EBC and denotified tribe students. It supports students at different education levels with financial help. Students usually apply through the National Scholarship Portal.

title: PM Virasat Ka Samvardhan (PM VIKAS)
objective: Skill training and entrepreneurship support for minority communities.
eligibility: Artisans, craftspersons, women, and youth belonging to notified minority communities (Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Buddhist, Parsi, Jain).
benefits: Skill development, master artisan apprentice training, design innovation, business incubator support, credit linkages, and market linkages across hunar haats to preserve traditional art forms.
how_to_apply: Apply through the Ministry of Minority Affairs portal or through accredited training partners and craft clusters.
documents_required: Aadhaar; Minority community certificate / self-declaration; Proof of traditional craft occupation; Bank passbook
summary_en: PM VIKAS is a scheme for minority communities. It combines skill training, leadership development and support for entrepreneurship, and aims to help people from minority communities build livelihoods.

title: Atal Vayo Abhyuday Yojana
objective: Support programmes for the welfare of senior citizens.
eligibility: Senior citizens (aged 60 and above), particularly indigent, poor, and vulnerable elderly persons.
benefits: Comprehensive elderly welfare umbrella: free assisted living devices (walking sticks, wheelchairs, hearing aids, spectacles under Rashtriya Vayoshri Yojana), running of Senior Citizen Homes, and Elderline national toll-free helpline (14567).
how_to_apply: Register for assistive devices at ALIMCO camps or through the Social Welfare Department, or call Elderline at 14567 for rescue, shelter, and medical support.
documents_required: Aadhaar / Age proof document; BPL card or Income certificate (for Rashtriya Vayoshri Yojana); Medical disability/impairment certificate
summary_en: This scheme supports programmes that improve the lives of senior citizens, such as helplines, day-care and support for elderly people. It is implemented mainly through organisations that work with the Ministry.

title: Fit India Movement
objective: Campaign to make fitness part of everyday life.
eligibility: Open to all citizens, schools, colleges, youth clubs, and corporate organizations across India.
benefits: Nationwide behavioral campaign encouraging daily physical activity, fitness protocols, Fit India School certifications, Freedom Runs, and Cyclothons.
how_to_apply: Register individuals, schools, or organizations at fitindia.gov.in to participate in fitness challenges and earn Fit India certificates.
documents_required: None for public participation; School/organization credentials for institutional certification
summary_en: Fit India Movement is a campaign to encourage people of all ages to include fitness in daily life. It runs through events, challenges and awareness campaigns across schools, offices and communities.

title: National Logistics Policy 2022
objective: Framework to lower logistics costs and improve efficiency.
eligibility: Logistics service providers, warehouse operators, transporters, exporters, and industrial manufacturers.
benefits: Reduces India's logistics cost to single-digit GDP levels through Unified Logistics Interface Platform (ULIP), Ease of Logistics (ELOG) single-window digital processing, and standardized warehousing assets.
how_to_apply: Logistics companies and developers can register on the ULIP portal (ulip.dpiit.gov.in) to access consolidated multi-modal transport and tracking APIs.
documents_required: Company registration; GSTIN; PAN; Transport / logistics operator license
summary_en: The National Logistics Policy sets a framework to lower the cost of moving goods and improve efficiency. It focuses on better digital systems, simpler procedures and better coordination between agencies. It is mainly relevant to businesses.

title: National Green Hydrogen Mission
objective: Mission to produce and use green hydrogen and cut fossil fuel dependence.
eligibility: Green hydrogen producers, electrolyser manufacturers, renewable energy developers, and industrial off-takers in fertilizer, steel, and transport sectors.
benefits: Strategic Interventions for Green Hydrogen Transition (SIGHT) financial incentives: direct production subsidies per kg of Green Hydrogen and capital incentives for domestic electrolyser manufacturing.
how_to_apply: Apply against competitive tenders and Request for Selection (RfS) issued by SECI (Solar Energy Corporation of India) on mnre.gov.in.
documents_required: Company incorporation; Audited financial statements; Technical feasibility report; Bank guarantee
summary_en: This mission aims to produce and use green hydrogen, made with renewable energy, as a clean fuel. It supports production, research and industry use, and is mainly relevant to industry and researchers.

title: Namami Gange
objective: Programme to clean and revive the river Ganga.
eligibility: Urban local bodies, industrial units, panchayats along the River Ganga basin, environmental organizations, and local riverfront communities.
benefits: Integrated river rejuvenation funding: Sewage Treatment Plants (STPs), riverfront development, industrial effluent monitoring, rural sanitation, afforestation, and biodiversity conservation.
how_to_apply: Public projects are executed by the National Mission for Clean Ganga (NMCG). Volunteers and citizens can participate through Ganga Vichar Manch on nmcg.nic.in.
documents_required: Municipal / institutional project tenders and registrations
summary_en: Namami Gange is the flagship programme to clean and revive the river Ganga. It works on sewage treatment, riverfront development and pollution control, and encourages community participation.

title: National Clean Air Programme
department: Ministry of Environment, Forest & Climate Change
objective: Plan to cut air pollution in the most affected cities.
eligibility: 131 non-attainment cities across 24 states and union territories not meeting National Ambient Air Quality Standards.
benefits: Targeted central funding to municipal corporations and state pollution control boards to expand ambient air monitoring networks, dust management, mechanical road sweepers, and EV charging infrastructure.
how_to_apply: City action plans are implemented directly by respective Municipal Corporations and State Pollution Control Boards; citizens can track live air quality via the PRANA portal (prana.cpcb.gov.in).
documents_required: None for public access
summary_en: The National Clean Air Programme sets out a plan to reduce air pollution in cities with poor air quality. Cities prepare local plans and work on sources such as dust, vehicles and burning of waste.

title: Mission LiFE
department: Ministry of Environment, Forest & Climate Change
objective: Campaign that encourages individuals to adopt environment-friendly habits.
eligibility: All citizens, households, educational institutions, businesses, and communities worldwide.
benefits: Global mass movement encouraging individual and community climate action through simple, measurable sustainable lifestyle changes (energy conservation, water saving, reducing single-use plastics, circular economy).
how_to_apply: Take the LiFE pledge and log sustainable lifestyle actions on the Mission LiFE portal (missionlife-moefcc.nic.in) or Meri LiFE app to earn eco-certificates.
documents_required: Name and mobile number/email to generate digital participation pledge
summary_en: Mission LiFE encourages individuals and communities to adopt environment-friendly habits such as saving energy and water, and cutting waste. It works through awareness and local action rather than applications.

title: PM Gati Shakti
objective: Digital master plan to coordinate infrastructure projects.
eligibility: Central ministries, state infrastructure departments, public infrastructure developers, and industrial planning agencies.
benefits: National Master Plan multi-modal connectivity platform integrating 16+ ministries on a shared GIS-based digital map to eliminate departmental silos, optimize project design, and accelerate infrastructure execution.
how_to_apply: Departments and authorized agencies plan and review infrastructure corridors via the BISAG-N developed PM Gati Shakti National Master Plan GIS platform (gatishakti.bisp.gov.in).
documents_required: Authorized departmental credentials; GIS spatial project layers
summary_en: PM Gati Shakti is a digital platform and master plan that coordinates infrastructure planning across ministries, so that roads, rail, ports and other projects connect better and save time and cost.
